name: A newly created leave type is immediately available in the New Request dropdown

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.

Open the 'Leave Types' page (URL /hr/leave-types), click 'Add leave type', fill Name with 'E2E Quick Type', set Attachment to 'Not required', set Default annual quota to 7, and click 'Save leave type'.
The leave types table now contains the row 'E2E Quick Type' with status 'Active'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.daycalc@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
The 'Leave type' dropdown now contains the option 'E2E Quick Type' (it is immediately available for new requests).
